_doc.zh: 膝周肌肉的经过点规则，由 tools/rig/via.ts 读取，在构建绑定时按本模型的骨网格放置（不取参照模型的坐标）。match 是去掉左右之后的小写肌肉名的正则。condyle：股骨髁后面的缠绕点（只在作用线会穿进股骨髁时起作用），anglesDeg 是以膝屈伸轴为心的极角（0 = 正后方，正值向近侧），半径 = 该处股骨面的最大半径 + clearanceMm；tibia：胫骨上的固定经过点，半径 = 胫骨面 + clearanceMm；patella：股四头肌经髌骨，经过点是髌骨点绕髌骨轴往近侧转 backDeg 度、固定在股骨上的位置（原在 data/curated/activity/params.json）；另沿髌骨轨道往远侧每 arcDeg 度放一个固定在股骨上的缠绕点，深屈时肌腱走弧线而不是弦。clearanceMm 约为肌腱的半径，是假设，不是测量值。
_doc.en: Via-point rules for the muscles round the knee, read by tools/rig/via.ts and placed on this model's bone meshes when the rig is built (no coordinates are taken from the reference models). match is a regex on the lower-case muscle name without its side. condyle: wrapping points behind the femoral condyles (in use only when the line would pass into the condyles); anglesDeg are polar angles about the knee's flexion axis (0 = straight back, positive proximal) and the radius is the largest radius of the femur's surface there plus clearanceMm. tibia: a fixed via point on the tibia, radius = the tibia's surface plus clearanceMm. patella: the quadriceps act through the patella; the via point is the patella point turned backDeg degrees proximally about the patellar axis and fixed to the femur (formerly in data/curated/activity/params.json); further wrapping points fixed to the femur lie along the patellar track at the angles arcDeg distal of it, so that in deep flexion the tendon follows the arc instead of its chord. clearanceMm is about a tendon's radius: an assumption, not a measurement.

rules.match: ^(long head of biceps femoris|short head of biceps femoris|semitendinosus|semimembranosus|gracilis|sartorius)$
^(medial head of gastrocnemius|lateral head of gastrocnemius)$
